scoring.maxScoreSubmission: The maximum score submission for each problem will be used.
scoring.maxScoreBatch: The maximum score for each problem batch will be used.
scoring.lastNonCeSubmission: The score on your **last** non-CE submission for each problem will be used.
scoring.penalty: Each submission before the first maximum score submission will incur a **penalty of {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}**.
scoring.firstAcBonus: There is a **{bonus} bonus** for fully solving on your first non-CE submission.
scoring.timeBonus: For every **{minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}** you submit before the end of your window, there will be a **1** point bonus.
scoring.tiesByLastSubmission: Ties will be broken by the sum of the last submission time on problems with a non-zero score.
scoring.tiesByScoreAltering: Ties will be broken by the sum of the last score altering submission time on problems with a non-zero score.
scoring.tiesByScoreAlteringThenLast: Ties will be broken by the sum of the last score altering submission time on problems with a non-zero score, followed by the time of the last score altering submission.
scoring.tiesByLastScoreAltering: Ties will be broken by the last score altering submission time.
scoring.tiesByAllProblems: Ties will be broken by the sum of the last submission time on **all** problems.
scoring.tiesNotBroken: Ties by score will **not** be broken.
